Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I keep repeating to my wife "I feel like I've been grilling with a handicap until now". 

The Weber Spirit II E-210 has been everything I wanted. It didn't look as fancy to me as some other grills, and I'm glad I got over that. The Weber creates such an even heat distribution that it's a dream to grill on. It heats up fast, get's the grates hot and ready, and retains it's heat as I open and close it to add food. I've seen mentions that "the flames don't reach the food!" and this is irrelevant. The grates add the grill marks to your food, not the flames. Flames over-cook your food, but the Weber's design keeps over-flaming from happening and let's me cook my food just how I want.

The extra heat also comes primarily out the back of the grill. This is a great design as I'm able to stand in front of my grill and be a cook, instead of trying to avoid flames and heat pockets. Do not put it right up to your home siding though, this grill needs some room behind it to vent. 

The grease tray is also a wonderful design. When the tray is full you slide it out and put in a new one. It's so simple! Yes they are over priced aluminum tray's, but they are darn convenient. 

Lastly, the weighted propane spring holder is nice to have. I've owned the grill for 2 months and have already ran through a propane tank. Either this grill uses a lot of propane, or I was severely underfilled on that propane tank. I've added 3 gallons of propane and the spring has said it's "full" for a lot longer now, so I think I had an underfilled tank before. As I'm able to just refill my tank instead of replace, it's nice to have the weighted spring that let's me know when I may be low and not ready for a heavy grilling weekend. 

Ultimately this 2-burner Weber grill has let me grill for an 8 person house party, without any issue. The grill didn't skip a beat when I loaded it up with hamburgers and hot dogs, and never created a mean flare-up from a fully loaded cooking top. I thought I had a good grill before that lasted me for years, but I would of bought a Weber 5 years ago had I known it was this good. 

If that last line sounded too cheesy, it's because I can melt cheese on a hamburger like it's an afterthought now. I'm that happy with the grill that I've become a walking Weber advertisement. I don't give a flip either, good food equals happy reviews.
Results.Title: Great Grilling for a Small Unit

Results.ReviewText: I had a weber grill for 12 years prior to buying this grill. Very pleased with the weber name.
Results.Title: Great grill, well built

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: The grill lives up to its reputation.  It is hard to make a mistake. All meat items I have done have come out tasty and juicy.
Results.Title: Easy to be a grill expert with this one

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Husband gave me for birthday gift, since my previous grill had a fire that burned one handle (due to user not tightening propane line properly!) Nice compact size with large capacity and ease of use.
Results.Title: Heats very quickly; getting an even cook so far.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I elected to assemble this grill myself and it was easy and fit and finish were outstanding. I have only used it twice so far but I love it! The igniter works fine and I like the convenient location of the battery. We don't usually grill for more then 2-4 people at a time and this grill  can manage 6-8 without a problem (depending on what you're grilling). You get what you pay for and Weber has delivered.
Results.Title: My Weber Spirit

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Bought this about 2 or 3 months ago and have used it several times. It been awesome so far!
Results.Title: So far soooo! Great

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: great grill , heats up fast and holds the heat so you save propane. Igniter works great as well. A little pricey but worth it. Only minor flaw is the cheap wheels and caps that come with it.
Results.Title: Heats up fast

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I got this grill as a Father's day gift and I'm very happy with it. Have used it to cook burgers, steaks, dogs, and last Sunday a whole chicken. It's dependable and easy to figure when stuff is done. And the 10 year warranty is reassuring. After all, we still have the Weber charcoal grill we got as a wedding gift -- in 1985!!
Results.Title: Good standard grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bought my grill a little over a month ago and have been using it regularly. It does a great job. I am very glad i bought this one.
Results.Title: Works Great

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
